result.summary: Found 4 issues including a cut-off restaurant card, truncated text, inconsistent heart icon styling, and horizontally clipped content that suggests a layout/scrolling problem.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' card in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the right edge of the screen, indicating the horizontal scroll container is not properly clipped or there's no visual cue (like a partial card fade) to indicate scrollability.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/gradient overlay at the edge of horizontally scrollable sections or ensure card widths are calculated so at least a clear partial preview is shown intentionally, signaling to users the content is scrollable.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated with no ellipsis styling handled cleanly, and it's unclear if the full name is visible elsewhere.
issues.suggestion: Ensure text truncation uses proper ellipsis CSS handling and consider shortening card width or font size to reduce truncation.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card is white/outline style while the heart icon on the pizza card below is a solid dark circle background - inconsistent styling between similar elements.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon button style (background color, icon fill state) across all food cards for visual consistency.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar's middle icon (search/scan) appears to have a long horizontal line through it that looks like a rendering glitch rather than an intentional icon design.
issues.suggestion: Review the icon asset for the search/scan navigation button to ensure it renders as intended without stray lines.
